name: shift_scheduling_template
description: The roster of examples/shift_scheduling.json with templates: ann, ben and cal over mon_day, mon_night, tue_day and tue_night with the same dislike table. Every shift is covered by exactly one person, nobody works more than 2 shifts, nobody works both shifts of a rest rule (mon_night then tue_day), and ben would rather not work mon_night (soft, weight 3). The rest rule lists its shifts by group: its index r is used only in the member's where. Optimum 7.
